sec.p: On futuro fortissimo we also talk about time. We've converted it into bananas (⚖️ ff.61.1 Measuring pollution in hours of life) and slowed it down, noticing the variations in everyday life (📝 ff.65.3 Homework for life).
I want a reckless life I want a life like the ones in the movies I want an over-the-top life I want a life like Steve McQueen Vasco Rossi, Vita Spericolata

sec.t: ff.111.3 Children, health and wasted years
sec.p: Bill asks us to “die with zero”. Clearly an impossible provocation (obviously nobody knows the day they'll die). But it reveals hidden inefficiencies in how we manage our finances:

Scandalous? With his hedonism, Bill seems to trample values like family, health and security for the future: to all intents and purposes a mental stumbling block (skàndalon), a stone on the main road.
